## Notes

Friendship 0-1000 (petting +15, unfed -20); mood 0-255; mood under 70 may skip production, quality products need mood 150; unfed animals stop producing but do not die; nightly birth check 50% base then about 0.55% per animal; hay for winter; open doors risk wild animal attacks.
